notes: Texts read from sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (card images) on 2026-11-09; the character card is 303 on sheet 3 (10x7, index 3). Sheet 176 is also Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's, Bigfoot's and the Tales to Amaze decks' DeckID: the CardIDs repeat and only the deck image tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

VOYAGE is the tag `voyage` (data/heroes/overlay/sinbad.json) and the HeroDef counter `voyage` is the number of tagged cards in the owner's discard pile; the cards read it with the Amount `{counter: voyage}` and the ability with the passive rule `maneuver_move_per_counter` (docs/effects-dsl.md, section 36). Everything else uses ops that already existed; no plugin.

ability.text: When you maneuver, you may move your fighters +1 space for each VOYAGE card in your discard pile.
ability.notes: A Maneuver moves each fighter up to its move value (+ the BOOST of the card spent) PLUS the number of VOYAGE cards in the discard pile, for the hero and The Porter alike ('your fighters'). The count is taken when the fighters move: a boost card spent in the same Maneuver is already in the pile (Voyage Home, the only VOYAGE card with a BOOST value, adds 1 to its own Maneuver). 'You may' costs nothing: moving less is always allowed.

cards.title: Feint
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Momentous Shift
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: If your fighter started this turn in a different space, this card's value is 5 instead.
cards.notes: Versatile 3 / boost 1, ANY. 'Your fighter' is the fighter that plays the card, attacking or defending; on the rival's turn it started the turn where it stands, unless an effect moved it. The printed 3 becomes 5, bonuses stay.

cards.title: Toil and Danger
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Move Sinbad up to 3 spaces.
cards.notes: Versatile 3 / boost 1, SINBAD only. The move is up to 3 (0 included), owner's choice, whatever the result.

cards.title: Voyage to the Cannibals With the Root of Madness
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: This card's value is +1 for each other VOYAGE card in your discard pile. AFTER COMBAT: You may move Sinbad up to 2 spaces.
cards.notes: Attack 2 / no boost, SINBAD only. The value is 2 plus the VOYAGE cards in the discard pile (the card in play is not there yet, so 'other' needs no exclusion).

cards.title: Voyage to the Creature With Eyes Like Coals of Fire
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: This card's value is +1 for each other VOYAGE card in your discard pile. AFTER COMBAT: Your opponent discards 1 random card.
cards.notes: Attack 2 / no boost, SINBAD only. The card is drawn by chance from the rival's hand; nobody looks.

cards.title: Voyage to the City of the King of Serendib
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: This card's value is +1 for each other VOYAGE card in your discard pile. AFTER COMBAT: Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Voyage to the Valley of the Giant Snakes
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: This card's value is +1 for each other VOYAGE card in your discard pile. AFTER COMBAT: Look at your opponent's hand.

cards.title: Regroup
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Draw 1 card. If you won the combat, draw 2 cards instead.
cards.notes: Versatile 1 / boost 1, ANY. 2 cards when the owner won (the engine's result: a tie or no damage is not a win for the attacker), else 1.

cards.title: Leap Away
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If you won the combat, choose one of the fighters in the combat and move them up to 4 spaces.
cards.notes: Versatile 4 / boost 1, ANY. The same shape as Skirmish: the owner chooses ONE of the two fighters of the combat (the rival's too) and where it goes, up to 4 spaces.

cards.title: Voyage Home
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: This card's value is +1 for each other VOYAGE card in your discard pile. AFTER COMBAT: Take all other VOYAGE cards from your discard pile and add them to your hand.
cards.notes: Attack 2 / boost 1, SINBAD only. The card in play is not in the discard pile yet, so it is never taken; the VOYAGE cards that are there (any number, 0 included) go to the hand; its own boost is the only VOYAGE boost on the deck.

cards.title: Voyage to the City of the Man-Eating Apes
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: This card's value is +1 for each other VOYAGE card in your discard pile. AFTER COMBAT: Deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter.
cards.notes: Attack 2 / no boost, SINBAD only. 2 effect damage to the other fighter of the combat.

cards.title: Voyage to the Island That Was a Whale
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: This card's value is +1 for each other VOYAGE card in your discard pile. AFTER COMBAT: Sinbad recovers 2 health.

hidden_info.card: Voyage to the Valley of the Giant Snakes
hidden_info.what: look_hand on the rival's hand after the combat.
hidden_info.bot_plays_it: The bot reads the human's hand ONLY when resolving this AFTER and keeps it as the human's KnownHand (docs/effects-dsl.md, section 6).
hidden_info.human_plays_it: The bot shows its hand in the chat.

hidden_info.card: Voyage to the Creature With Eyes Like Coals of Fire
hidden_info.bot_plays_it: Nobody looks: the human is told the position of the hand to discard from, counting from the left.
hidden_info.human_plays_it: The card is drawn by chance from the bot's hand and the table follows.

open_questions: Momentous Shift: 'your fighter' is read as the fighter that plays the card, attacking or defending (the same reading as Bigfoot's identical card).
The ability: 'your fighters' includes The Porter, and the count includes a VOYAGE card spent as the Maneuver's boost (Voyage Home, the only one with a BOOST value).
